recipes.name: Artichoke-Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked regular long-grain white rice
1 small red bell pepper, chopped (1/2 cup)
1 can (14 oz) artichoke hearts, drained, cut into fourths
sentences: Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours until chilled.

recipes.name: Barbecue Chicken Bacon Ranch Cheese Dip
ingredients: 2 cups shredded sharp Cheddar cheese (8 oz)
3 green onions, thinly sliced, green and white parts separated
sentences: Heat oven to 350°F.
Spray 8-inch square (2-quart) glass baking dish with cooking spray.
In medium bowl, mix 1 1/2 cups of the Cheddar cheese, the cream cheese, sour cream and ranch dip mix.
Top with remaining 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese, then top with cooked bacon.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until hot and bubbling at edges.

recipes.name: Cake Pop Cake
ingredients: 2 boxes Betty Crocker™ Super Moist™ Butter Recipe Yellow Cake Mix
2 tubs (12 oz) Betty Crocker™ Whipped Butter Cream Frosting
1 bag (14 to 16 oz) white candy melts
1 bag (14 to 16 oz) orange candy melts
1 bag (14 to 16 oz) blue candy melts
6 to 8 drinking straws or paper lollipop sticks
sentences: Heat oven to 350°F (325°F for dark or nonstick pans).
Generously grease 13x9-inch pan and 2 (8-inch) round baking pans and lightly flour, or spray with baking spray with flour.
Make 1 cake mix as directed on box, using 3 of the eggs, 1/3 cup of the butter and 1 cup of the water.
Pour into 13x9-inch pan.
Cool 10 minutes.
Cool completely, about 1 hour.
Make second cake mix, using remaining 3 eggs, 1/3 cup butter and 1 cup water.
Pour into 8-inch pans.
Cool 10 minutes.
Cool completely, about 1 hour.
Crumble 13x9-inch cake into large bowl.
Add 1 container of frosting; mix well.
Shape by 2 tablespoonfuls into balls. (You should end up with 34 to 36 cake balls; you will need 32 for the cake.) Place on cookie sheet.
Freeze at least 15 minutes.
In 2 separate microwavable bowls, microwave white and orange candy melts as directed on bag.
Dip tip of 1 lollipop stick into melted candy and insert stick halfway into 1 cake ball.
Meanwhile, place 1 cake layer on serving plate; spread with some of the frosting from second container.

recipes.name: Cheddar-Stuffed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (1 1/4 pounds)
sentences: Heat oven to 375°F.
Spray square pan, 9x9x2 inches, with cooking spray.
Flatten each chicken breast half to 1/4-inch thickness between sheets of plastic wrap or waxed paper.
Cut cheese into 4 slices, about 3x1x1/4 inches.
Place 1 slice cheese on center of each chicken breast half.
Bake uncovered about 30 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip M&M'S® Christmas Cookies
ingredients: 4 1/4 cups Gold Medal™ All Purpose Flour
1 bag (12 oz) semisweet chocolate chips (2 cups)
2 cups M&M'S® milk chocolate candies (about 14 oz)
sentences: Heat oven to 375°F.
On an ungreased cookie sheet, drop dough by level teaspoonfuls or #70 cookie/ice cream scoop about 2 inches apart.
Bake 10 to 11 minutes or until light brown (centers will be soft).
Cool 1 to 2 minutes; remove from cookie sheet to cooling rack.

recipes.name: Christmas Lights Cupcakes
ingredients: 1 box Betty Crocker™ Super Moist™ Devil’s Food Cake Mix
Water, vegetable oil and eggs called for on cake mix box
1 tub (16 oz) Betty Crocker™ Rich & Creamy Vanilla Frosting
Betty Crocker™ Red and Green Cookie Icings
sentences: Heat oven to 375°F (350°F for dark or nonstick pans).
Place paper baking cup in each of 21 regular-size muffin cups.
Bake 14 to 19 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove from pans to cooling rack.
Cool completely, about 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Easy Lemon Thumbprint Cookies
ingredients: 1 pouch (17.5 oz) Betty Crocker™ Sugar Cookie Mix
Flour, butter and egg called for on cookie mix pouch for cutout cookies
sentences: Heat oven to 375°F.
Shape into 50 (1-inch) balls.
Place balls, sugared side up, 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake 7 to 9 minutes or until edges are set.
Cool 2 minutes on cookie sheets.
Using end of wooden spoon, make 1/2-inch circle indentation in center of each cookie.
Cool completely, about 20 minutes.
Squeeze bag to fill opening, about 1/4 teaspoon per cookie.

recipes.name: Gingerbread Brownie Cutouts
ingredients: 1 box Betty Crocker™ Fudge Brownie Mix
Water, vegetable oil and eggs called for on brownie mix box
1 pouch (7 oz) Betty Crocker™ Decorating Cookie Icing white icing
24 M&M's® minis milk chocolate candies or red cinnamon candies
sentences: Heat oven to 350°F.
Line 13x9-inch pan with foil, letting foil hang 2 inches over sides of pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted 2 inches from side of pan comes out clean.
Transfer to cooling rack to cool completely, about 1 hour.
Freeze in pan 30 minutes.
Cut out 8 gingerbread men using 3-inch gingerbread man cookie cutter.
Let stand about 30 minutes or until icing is set.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Ultimate Chicken Fingers
ingredients: 3/4 cup Bisquick™ Gluten Free pancake & baking mix
3 boneless skinless chicken breasts (1 lb), cut crosswise into 1/2-inch strips
sentences: Heat oven to 450°F.
Bake 12 to14 minutes, turning after 6 minutes, until no longer pink in center.

recipes.name: Italian Sausage Lasagna
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil leaves or 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves
2 cups Muir Glen™ organic diced tomatoes (from 28-oz can), undrained
1 can (15 oz) Muir Glen™ organic tomato sauce
1 container (15 oz) ricotta cheese or small-curd cottage cheese (2 cups)
1 tablespoon chopped fresh oregano leaves or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves
sentences: In 10-inch skillet, cook sausage, onion and garlic over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until sausage is no longer pink; drain.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of the parsley, the basil, sugar, tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Reduce heat to low; simmer uncovered about 45 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Heat oven to 350°F.
In medium bowl, mix ricotta cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, remaining 1 tablespoon parsley and the oregano.
Spread 1 cup of the sauce mixture in ungreased 13x9-inch (3-quart) glass baking dish.
Top with 4 noodles.
Spread 1 cup of the cheese mixture over noodles; spread with 1 cup of the sauce mixture.
Sprinkle with 2/3 cup of the mozzarella cheese.
Repeat with 4 noodles, the remaining cheese mixture, 1 cup of the sauce mixture and 2/3 cup of the mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Cover; bake 30 minutes.
Uncover; bake about 15 minutes longer or until hot and bubbly.
Let stand 15 minutes before cutting.
